study: CogAlpha bounded mechanism replication with live DeepSeek proposals and budget-matched evolution ablation
reproduction_level: mechanism replication and literal worked examples on a different frozen dataset; not exact Table 1/5 replication

data.universe: 1000-stock static A-share research snapshot; not historical CSI300 constituents
data.factor_prices: raw OHLC multiplied by contemporaneous adj_factor / first observed adj_factor
data.factor_volume: share volume multiplied by first observed adj_factor / contemporaneous adj_factor, preserving raw dollar turnover
data.eligibility: existing point-in-time eligible mask, with no use of forward labels
data.known_bias: static snapshot membership and survivorship; corporate action adjustment is a research approximation

evaluation.mi_estimator: daily rank-quintile plug-in mutual information, natural logarithm; source estimator unpublished

parent_policy: Use qualified candidates, elite first; if none qualify under the substitute MI estimator, explicitly record a relaxed engineering pool ordered by positive train RankIC; no invented qualification. Use no test or validation feedback.

final_selection.ranking: positive training mean RankIC descending, id tie break
final_selection.difference_from_paper: source does not disclose final 20 expressions or complete final-selection code; local rule fixed before runs

portfolio.execution: close t scores, open t+1 fills; retain units of kept stocks
portfolio.unit_limitation: fractional adjusted total-return units, not exchange lots; no live trading

primary_comparison: llm_evolved49 versus llm_fresh49, LightGBM, test-period RankIC; report all three independent proposal replicates
stop_rule: No parameter or winner replacement after test results; preserve rejected proposals and negative findings
